summary: BOLAKS GROUP AS (org. no. 929 068 319) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bjørnafjorden, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2022-04-13. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 03.211 (Produksjon av fisk, bløtdyr, krepsdyr og pigghuder i sjø og brakkvann). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 12.6 m and net income was NOK 4.4 m. Group (consolidated) revenue was NOK 1.24 bn. CEO: Gerhard Meidell Alsaker; board chair: Grunde Bruland; auditor: KPMG AS.
